intent: A crown of four or five petal glades on short necks round a round sacred clearing, where a ring path circles the Moonwell's stone-ringed black pool and two bowed woodland tracks carry the road in through one petal and out through another.
requests: A water or drowned-ground cell kind (or a pool site kind), so still water and a causeway over it can be part of the walkable layout instead of only flat pool props.
A way for a draft landmark to carry a tileset light: the moonwell look's own smaller well ring glows teal, while the draft's landmark ring at the heart cannot.
A way to reserve the look's own quiet sacred_ring prop, so a draft that places the well itself does not also get the look's second, lit ring in the same clearing.
